scope.deduplication: Direct Claude Code skill folders in the user skill root and one selected project skill root.
scope.restoration: Only CCTI-owned timestamped backup folders whose original destination is empty.
scope.privacy: Fixture-only evidence; real user paths, file contents, credentials, and environment values are excluded.

assertions.corruptedBackupManifest: verified by changing a nested backup file after review; apply rejects the restore and leaves both backup and original destination unchanged
assertions.missingBackupFile: verified by removing SKILL.md after review; apply fails safely, preserves the remaining backup folder, and leaves the original destination unchanged
assertions.noOverwriteRestore: verified by an occupied original skill destination fixture
assertions.newestBackupSelection: verified when multiple timestamped backups target the same original destination
assertions.independentProjectPortability: verified with separately named fixture roots and differently named skills with identical complete content
assertions.ariaLiveInventory: verified in a rendered hidden Electron window
assertions.backupAndRestoreAnnouncements: verified as polite status announcements with preview-heading focus transfer

backupAnnouncement.text: Review 1 exact file across 1 skill folder. The next action moves only these files into the shown backup locations.

restoreAnnouncement.text: Review 1 exact file across 1 skill folder. The next action moves only these files into the shown original Claude Code locations.
